intent: After Level 5 hardening, anonymous probes of internal routes return 401. This case is HTTP-only — it doesn't go through the agent loop. The harness's runner-mode-http supports this via meta.http_probes.

input.userText: Run a security probe of my own deployed service. Use the curl tool to verify GET / returns 401 and POST /api/cron/fire returns 401, then report status.
